dct_description_sm: This data layer contains polygon features representing public parks of Riverside County. Included within the data are national forests and parks, county parks and preserves, city parks, and community parks. The data is collected from various government agencies such as the city governments, park and recreation districts, county and state governments, and US Forest Service. Spatial accuracy of parks is based of Riverside County parcels. Due to parcel shift, please perform spatial analysis with care.*Updated 08/22/2012 with parks from City of Riverside, Moreno Valley, and Riverside vicinity. P.KangPark name corrections and additional parks added 6/2014
